scenario: 今天的个性化赛道围着模型该怎么把有限容量用在真正有用的信号上展开。一篇针对端侧序列推荐，指出同一套压缩比例会让简单请求浪费算力、复杂请求又不够用，于是按排序是否稳定来分配通道和历史长度。另一篇则回到表格模型里的特征交叉：普通多层感知机把组合埋在隐层里，作者把乘积写进残差块，并在科学回归基准上检查模型是否把力气花在了已知的交叉上。对做推荐的人来说，前者关乎端侧排序怎么按请求调容量，后者提醒显式交叉不仅是为了把误差压下去，也是为了让人能检查模型到底抓住了哪些组合。

papers.title: RACE: Ranking-Uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation
papers.authors: Tianqi Liu, Kaipu Sun, Kairui Fu, Wenkai Wang, Sihao Liu, Hui Zang, Ran Chen, Tao Wang, Shengyu Zhang
papers.abstract: Efficient sequential recommendation has emerged as a promising paradigm for providing real-time personalized service. To deploy models under resource-constrained environment, model compression becomes a necessity, yet existing methods typically apply uniform compression ratios, overlooking the heterogeneity in user intent complexity. This "one-size-fits-all" approach leads to a fundamental Capacity-Complexity Mismatch, where computational resources are either wasted on simple instances or insufficient for complex ones. To address this, we propose RACE (Ranking-uncertainty Aware Capacity-Adaptive Customization for Efficient Sequential Recommendation), a framework that dynamically adapts both model structures and input sequences with uncertainty-aware compression ratios. To ensure capacity-adaptive inference, RACE captures the model's intrinsic uncertainty of its predictions and transforms it into a proactive resource allocator. Specifically, we derive a list-wise ranking-uncertainty metric from the distributional stability of top-$K$ predictions, which serves as a measurable proxy for instance complexity. A lightweight predictor is then trained via self-supervision to anticipate this uncertainty from early-layer features. Guided by this signal, RACE performs instance-specific slimming in two dimensions: a hypernetwork-style channel sensitivity extractor identifies parameter redundancy, while importance-aware progressive sequence filtering mitigates data redundancy. Extensive experiments on four popular datasets demonstrate that RACE outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability.
papers.scoring_note: 序列推荐动态压缩；四数据集，摘要无量化增益；实现与线上验证未确认。
papers.summary: 端侧做序列推荐时，模型压缩常常用同一套比例对待所有请求，兴趣简单的浪费算力，兴趣复杂的又不够用。现有剪枝或分解方法多半先给模型和输入定死一个尺寸，很难跟着这次行为序列的难度调整容量。作者用模型对当前排序结果稳不稳来估计这次有多难，再据此决定保留多少通道、截掉多长历史。以 SASRec 为骨干，在常用数据上平均来看，排序质量指标 NDCG 比未压缩的原模型提高 40.87%，计算量同时减半还多。换更紧或更松的推理预算时，也不用重新训练。==简单请求和难请求不该共用同一套压缩比==。对要在手机或边缘设备上跑个性化排序的人来说，按请求难度分配容量，比先压成一个固定小模型更划算。

papers.title: Learning nonlinear interactions and cross-feature couplings with product-unit residual networks
papers.authors: Ziyuan Li, Uwe Jaekel, Babette Dellen
papers.abstract: Understanding nonlinear feature interactions is crucial in science and engineering, yet standard multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) often capture such interactions only implicitly, leading to entangled representations that can impair robustness and interpretability. We investigate complex-valued product-unit residual networks (CV-PURe) that integrate multiplicative product units with residual connections to explicitly model cross-feature couplings while stabilizing optimization. We conduct a systematic evaluation on an interaction-driven synthetic benchmark and real-world datasets and evaluate prediction together with input-level interaction recovery under a reproducible protocol. Across five data splits and five training seeds, CV-PURe achieves the lowest mean RMSE on four of six scientific benchmarks, reducing Friedman error by 53.9% relative to MLP. Its Friedman interaction maps assign 60.7% of total strength to the known interacting pair, compared with 31.0% for MLP. On a synthetic task containing third- and fourth-order products and 20 distractors, CV-PURe reduces RMSE from 0.1376 to 0.0797 relative to a complex-valued MLP and recovers all nine true pairwise projections in every training/sampling repetition. Bike Sharing experiments connect improved prediction to the contribution of temporal, calendar, and seasonal context through paired ablations of both PURe variants. Parkinsons Telemonitoring extends the context analysis to repeated measurements. Noise and learning-curve evaluations demonstrate sustained predictive gains under perturbed inputs and limited supervision, while inference measurements quantify computational cost. This article extends our ICCS 2026 paper, Modeling Nonlinear Feature Interactions with Product-Unit Residual Networks (doi:10.1007/978-3-032-29921-5_6).
papers.scoring_note: 显式乘积特征交叉可迁移；科学回归基准，无CTR验证。
papers.summary: 表格模型要预测由多个因素交叉决定的结果时，普通多层感知机往往把交叉关系埋在隐层里，误差不一定差，但很难判断它是不是抓住了真正起作用的组合。推荐里常用的 FM 和交叉网络也是在显式做特征相乘，这篇把乘积运算写进残差块，并用复数权重同时表示幅度和相位，让优化更稳。在经典的 Friedman 函数上，均方根误差比普通多层感知机低 53.9%。交互图里有 60.7% 的强度集中在那个已知的成对关系上，普通网络只有 31.0%。==预测变准，是因为模型把力气花在了真正的交叉上==。这些对比做在科学回归基准上，对做点击率或转化这类也靠特征交叉的模型来说，显式乘法和残差提供了一种可检查的结构，而不是只让隐层自己去学组合。
